dedupeText: soulful portrait album cover r b 90s aesthetic turtleneck leather chair low angle portrait warm lighting script and sans serif pairing the diagonal line of the man s body creates a dynamic flow from bottom left to top right the light texture of the ribbed sweater contrasts against the dark smooth leather of the chair the typography frames the subject with the name at the top and the title at the bottom right combine a low angle textured clothing portrait with a dual font strategy using a wide geometric sans serif for the name and a formal script for the title

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-angle portrait of a man reclining on a dark leather chair, wearing a light-colored ribbed turtleneck. The composition is intimate and moody, characterized by soft film grain and a warm, interior color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the man's body creates a dynamic flow from bottom-left to top-right.
The light texture of the ribbed sweater contrasts against the dark, smooth leather of the chair.
The typography frames the subject, with the name at the top and the title at the bottom-right.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject
Soft-focus background with domestic interior elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the majority of the frame, positioned diagonally from the bottom-left corner toward the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and direct gaze toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, follows the line of the arm down to the bottom left, then moves across the sweater to the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper-left and bottom-right corners where text is placed.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and deep mahoganies from the leather and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream and off-white from the ribbed turtleneck.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Skin tones and subtle silver highlights from jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on mid-tones and deep shadows, creating a cozy, intimate atmosphere.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and elegant formal script.
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a wide, thin-stroke geometric sans-serif with open counters.
Bottom text uses a fluid, slanted formal script with high stroke contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' in the top text is nearly a perfect circle.
The script 'E' features a prominent decorative loop.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a modern, clean sans-serif and a traditional, romantic script.
graphicDevices: Soft drop shadows to ensure legibility against complex backgrounds.

preserve: The thin weight of the top font
The italicized flow of the bottom font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide geometric structure and thin strokes of the header.
Provides the necessary formal elegance and stroke contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-quality photograph of a man with short hair reclining on a dark brown leather sofa. He is wearing a cream-colored ribbed turtleneck sweater. The lighting is warm and domestic, coming from the side. The camera angle is low, looking up. The image should have a slight film grain and a soft, 1990s R&B aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the artist name at the top in a thin, wide white geometric sans-serif font. Place the album title in the bottom right corner using a white, elegant formal script font with a slight drop shadow for readability.

verificationChecks: Does the sweater have a visible ribbed texture?
Is the top font thin and geometric?
Is the bottom font a high-contrast script?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any specific brand logos on the clothing or jewelry
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the background.
Ensure the diagonal composition is maintained.
Verify the warm, desaturated color palette.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is present.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle, textured-clothing portrait with a dual-font strategy using a wide geometric sans-serif for the name and a formal script for the title.
